bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Prohibiting Energy Market Misconduct) Bill 2018

name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2018-12-05.134.1) introduced by Sturt MP [Christopher Pyne](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/sturt/christopher_pyne) (Liberal), which means it passed and debate on this motion will resume at a later date. ### Motion text > *That the resumption of debate on the motion that the bill be read a second time be made an order of the day for a later hour.*
